hero.badge: AI-powered prep for NEET · JEE · KCET
hero.title: AI that understands how you learn
hero.text: TutorMind tracks every practice attempt, finds the topics quietly costing you marks, and builds your next session automatically — so you always know exactly what to practice next.

preview.readinessAria: Sample exam readiness score {{score}} out of 100
preview.caption: JEE Main · Preview

why.subtext: Every practice session is analyzed to improve exam-readiness with actionable guidance — not just another question bank.

adaptive.title: Adaptive practice engine
adaptive.copy: Every attempt updates a live model of your strengths, so the next question is always the right level of challenge — not too easy, not demoralizing.

weak.title: Weak-topic detection
weak.copy: TutorMind watches accuracy and time-per-question across every subject to surface exactly where you’re losing marks, before the exam does.

sim.title: Exam-day simulation
sim.copy: Full-length, negative-marking-aware mock tests that mirror real NEET/JEE/KCET timing, so exam day feels like just another practice session.

analytics.title: Actionable analytics
analytics.copy: No vanity charts — every insight comes with a next step: which topic to revise, which question type to drill, and when to retest.

personal.title: A study plan that rewrites itself around you
personal.text: Instead of a fixed syllabus checklist, TutorMind keeps a live performance profile per topic — accuracy, response time, and how recently you practiced it — and uses that to decide what you see next.
personal.b1: Detects weak topics before a mock test does
personal.b2: Prioritizes questions you're due to review
personal.b3: Adjusts difficulty as you improve, automatically

subjects.title: Built for NEET, JEE, and KCET preparation
subjects.subtext: Pick your exam track — every question bank is mapped to the syllabus that matters for it.

neet.detail: NCERT-aligned question banks with diagram-heavy Botany & Zoology coverage.

jee.detail: Concept-linked problem sets from JEE Main difficulty up through Advanced-style multi-step problems.

cet.detail: State-syllabus-matched practice for Karnataka CET aspirants, alongside NEET/JEE prep.

practice.title: Practice questions
practice.copy: Start with a diagnostic set or jump straight into a subject and topic you want to drill.

analyze.title: System analyzes performance
analyze.copy: Accuracy, timing, and attempt patterns are scored after every question — not just at the end of a test.

recommend.title: Get personalized recommendations
recommend.copy: Your next practice set adapts automatically, prioritizing the topics most likely to move your score.

testimonials.title: What students are saying

exams.a: TutorMind is built specifically for NEET, JEE (Main-style), and Karnataka CET preparation, with subject coverage across Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, and Biology.

engine.q: How does the recommendation engine decide what to show me next?
engine.a: Every attempt updates a per-topic performance profile — accuracy, time taken, and recency. The system prioritizes topics where you’re both weak and due for review, instead of repeating what you already know.

free.a: Yes — the Free plan includes daily practice sets and basic performance tracking so you can try the adaptive experience before upgrading.

cancel.q: Can I cancel or change plans anytime?
cancel.a: Yes, plans are month-to-month and you can upgrade, downgrade, or cancel from your account settings at any time.

cta.title: Start your smart preparation today
cta.text: Join TutorMind and let your practice sessions tell you exactly what to study next.

jee.purpose: JEE Main is used primarily for admission-related purposes to undergraduate engineering and architecture/planning programs, as specified by the relevant institutions and admission authorities.

kcet.purpose: KCET/UGCET is a Karnataka state-level entrance examination used for admission to various professional undergraduate courses according to KEA rules.
